title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的诞生

texts.zh:
自从我们意识到自己不是寰宇之中的孤独之身后，不受外交关系影响的实质星系贸易就一直存在着。随着星系的边境线被不断刷新，旧的商路也不断重绘，星际领袖们同意应该使这种贸易市场合法化，让大家都可从中受益。

在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如果该贸易中心坐落于[Root.GetAdj]境内，一定会使我们受益，因此我们可以宣传我们的一颗星球作为位置候选。
texts.en:
De facto galactic trade, unbound by the performance of international diplomacy, has existed since we first discovered that we are not alone in the universe. As new borders are discovered and old ones redrawn across the galaxy, galactic leaders agree that it is time to legitimize this commercial forum so that all may benefit.

In the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. We would surely benefit were this hub to fall within [Root.GetAdj] space, so we can choose to promote one of our worlds for this purpose.

texts.zh:
遗憾的是，我们一直未能有效地打击与异种社会的违法贸易。同样令人遗憾的是，这一不受外交关系影响而且几乎匿名的贸易市场带来了实实在在的利润。

在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如能主导此贸易中心的运营，想必一定会比囤积外星货物要有用得多，因此我们可以宣传我们的一颗星球作为位置候选。
texts.en:
It is a regrettable fact that we have consistently failed to quash the illicit trade with the xenos. Equally regrettable is that the economic benefits of a largely anonymous forum for trade decoupled from international relations cannot be denied.

In the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. The economic gains from playing host to such a nexus might well outweigh the burden of harboring alien goods, so we can choose to promote one of our worlds for this purpose.

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：未成立

texts.zh:
很不幸，我们发起的建立泛星系贸易市场的动议碰壁了。虽然我们明显成功地为该计划调动了政治意愿，但却没收到任何有效的主办地提名。

原则上，商业说客和政治拥趸都支持这个想法，并发誓会加倍努力，只要[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]希望再次尝试。
texts.en:
Our motion to bring forth a new Galactic Market has unfortunately failed. While we clearly succeeded in mustering the political will for such a scheme, it did not receive any valid nominations for a host site.

Commercial lobbyists and political proponents alike stand by the idea in principle, having vowed to redouble their efforts should the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] wish to try again.

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：未成立

texts.zh:
看来星系的市场范围无法承载其政治意图。苦于缺乏有效的主办地提名，最近 [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]为构建专门的交易中心而做出的努力都白费了。

泛星系贸易市场计划的支持者们旋即表明一点都不觉得尴尬，声称只要[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]认为时机成熟，他们将再次提出自己的主张。
texts.en:
It would seem the galaxy's political will has exceeded the reach of its markets. Recent efforts by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] to establish a dedicated trading hub have failed, with no valid nominations for a host site.

Proponents of the Galactic Market scheme were quick to deny any hint of embarrassment, declaring that they will make their case again whenever the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] considers itself ready.

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的市场范围无法承载其政治意图，因为最近他们为形成统一的泛星系贸易市场而做出的努力都白费了。到头来，异种人备受推崇的项目连一个有效的主办地提名都没能吸引到。

计划的支持者否认这表明异星人的“合作”想法是弄巧成拙。相反，他们坚定地宣称，如果星系的成员认为时机成熟了，可以再次尝试。
texts.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s political will has exceeded the reach of its markets, as their recent effort to form a unified Galactic Market has failed. After all was said and done, the xenos' much-vaunted project couldn't entice a single valid nomination for a host site.

Proponents of the scheme have denied that this exposes the true folly behind ideas about xeno 'collaboration'. Instead they are resolute in claims that the galaxy may try again, when its members consider themselves ready.

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的成立

texts.zh: 国际贸易论坛即将成立，而其中央贸易空间站的控制者必将从中获益。[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]
texts.en: The establishment of an international commercial forum is nigh, and whoever controls the centralized exchange station stands to benefit.[GetMarketFoundingChainEnd]

The customers, clients, and rubes of the galaxy at long last seem ready to accept a quasi-centralized platform for deregulated, mid-scale international commerce.

We can promote one of our worlds to play host to this commercial hub, to maximize potential revenue.

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：已成立

texts.zh: 泛星系贸易中心已被设立在[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]恒星系，位于[From.GetName]境内。[From.GetAdj]政府已经正式宣布这一市场合法，资源已经可以通过中立第三方进行买卖。
texts.en: The center of galactic commerce has manifested in the [galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName] system, within the borders of the [From.GetName]. The [From.GetAdj] administration has officially legitimized this marketplace, where resources can be bought and sold through unaffiliated third parties.

texts.zh: 心怀鬼胎的[From.GetName]异种建立了一个外星商品的交易市场。尽管我们对此不屑一顾，但市场的大门仍对我们敞开。
texts.en: The dubious xenos of the [From.GetName] have established a marketplace for the trade of alien goods. While we are naturally loath to take part in this exchange, the option is available to us.
